title: The Crystal Caves
subtitle: Clues before guesses
opening: The cave crystals have lost their song. Somewhere below the mountain, a tiny bell rings.
ending: Pip opens the mountain trail. The stolen crystal went to Emberwing, but her fire is tangled in black vines. Only the Frost Queen knows how to get close.
not_yet: That place is resting. Follow the glowing landmark on your quest card.

steps.title: The cave that forgot its song
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: I hear someone hiding, Liza. Follow the clues at our three landmarks. Find out who took the crystal before you decide why.

steps.title: Follow the little thief
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Search every landmark for a clue. The Moon Crystal holds a Sooty Footprint, the Elder Tree a Blue Thread, and the Treasure Chest a Bent Spoon.

steps.title: Pip tells the truth
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Please do not zap me! I am Pip. I carried the Heart Crystal to Emberwing. She said her egg was getting cold. I thought I was helping. I did not know the pools would get sick.

steps.title: A lantern for hidden things
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Pip knows how to make a seeing spell. Find a Prism Chip at the Moon Crystal, a Listening Leaf at the Elder Tree, and a Looking Glass at the Treasure Chest.

steps.title: The Truthlight spell
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Back already? Prism, leaf, and looking glass: show us what the shadows hide. Your new spell is Truthlight. A clue is better than a guess.

steps.title: Light the crystal echoes
steps.clue: Take Truthlight to the Treasure Chest, then the Moon Crystal, then the Elder Tree. Three echoes will show the journey of our missing crystal.
steps.speaker: Pip

steps.title: A shadow in the picture
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: There! The crystal is beside a dragon egg. But those black vines were not there before. Something is drinking its light. I can hear Emberwing asking for help.

steps.title: Pip lends his bell
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Visit the Treasure Chest and take Pip’s Copper Bell. Ring it with your wand so the mountain knows you are a friend.

steps.title: The hidden stair
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Go back to the Moon Crystal. Truthlight reveals a stair behind the stone. Wave to open the way up Frozen Mountain.

steps.title: A promise to put things right
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: I will help the fairies mend their pools while you find the Frost Queen. Please tell Emberwing I am sorry. Next time, I will ask before I borrow.
